addressed.claim_id: Float ratio entries are now rejected with ValueError instead of being converted via Decimal(str(entry)) — removed float-conversion branch and added explicit float rejection.

Total decimal-place validation no longer depends on Decimal.quantize with default context precision — replaced with normalized-exponent check (trailing-zero stripping) so very large finite totals do not raise InvalidOperation, plus made cents conversion and share computation exact via scaleb and Fraction to handle large values.
Fixed total decimal-places validation to reject exponent < -2 without trailing-zero normalization or zero bypass (e.g. "10.000", "10.5000", "0.000")
Fixed exact cents conversion and part construction to avoid context-precision rounding via Fraction integer arithmetic and Decimal tuple construction with exponent -2
